import.title: Import from Yarn Spinner
import.description: Bring an existing .yarn file or Yarn project archive into Storyarn. Review the preview before anything is changed.
import.file_help: Maximum 50 MB. Archives are inspected for unsafe paths and expansion before extraction.
import.strategy_rename: Keep both by renaming imported content
import.compatibility_warnings: Some Yarn-specific commands, markup, or dynamic text cannot be converted exactly. They are preserved visibly and flagged for review.
import.compatibility_summary_description: Aggregated counts only. Storyarn does not expose imported text or examples in this summary.
import.compatibility_counts_complete: Some individual issues are omitted from the preview, but these aggregate counts include all of them.
import.compatibility_acknowledgement: I also reviewed the compatibility warning counts and accept the documented conversions.
import.compatibility_errors_blocking: Compatibility errors must be resolved before this review can be validated.
import.compatibility_summary_invalid: The compatibility summary is incomplete or malformed. Validate the source file again before importing.
import.review_description: Choose how Storyarn should treat every Yarn line prefix. Suggestions are never applied automatically.
import.review_create_sheet_description: Use this prefix as a dialogue speaker and create its character sheet.
import.review_preserve_literal_description: Keep it in the dialogue text as a presentation or technical channel, without creating a character.
import.review_map_to_sheet_description: Treat this less frequent alias as the same speaker and use the {target} character sheet.
import.review_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total}. The complete totals were used for the import decision.
import.review_truncated_blocking: Showing {shown} of {total}. This review must be complete before importing.
import.review_incomplete_truncated: This review is truncated. Import is blocked because Storyarn cannot collect a decision for every prefix.
import.review_incomplete: This Yarn review is incomplete or has an unsupported shape. Import is blocked; validate the file again.
import.review_undecided: Choose an action for every Yarn prefix before importing.
import.review_missing: This Yarn preview does not include the required prefix review. Import is blocked; validate the file again.
import.review_error_failed: The request did not complete. Check your connection and try again.
import.review_error_save: Your selections could not be saved.
import.review_error_stale: This review is out of date; the import state has changed.
import.review_error_unauthorized: You no longer have permission to import into this project.
import.review_validated: This exact selection has been validated. You can now start the import.
import.review_needs_validation: Validate this complete selection before starting the import.
import.review_aliases_description: These names may be typos or aliases. Storyarn only maps them when you choose an explicit target.
import.review_alias_mapping_available: You can now choose “Map {alias} to {target}” in the {alias} classification.
import.review_alias_mapping_requires_target: Choose “Create a character sheet” for {target} to enable explicit alias mapping.
import.review_acknowledgement: I reviewed every prefix classification and the possible aliases. Storyarn will not merge aliases automatically.

review_evidence.literal_character_name: Used as a literal Yarn character name.
review_evidence.repeated_scoped_presentation_channel: Repeated only inside matching presentation command regions that use the corresponding clear command.
review_evidence.single_adjacent_transposition_with_domin: The names differ by one adjacent transposition and one is used much more often.
review_evidence.dynamic_speaker_expression: The speaker is computed from a Yarn variable and cannot safely identify one character sheet.
review_evidence.same_nfkc_casefold: The names differ only by Unicode normalization or letter case.

import.processing_description: You can leave this page. The encrypted import plan is processed in the background.
import.success: The Yarn project was imported successfully.
import.no_permission: Only project owners can import into this project.

errors.cancelled: The import was cancelled. No project content was changed.
errors.discarded: This import could not be validated and was discarded. Validate the file again before importing.
errors.expired: The import could not run before its retention deadline. No project content was changed.
errors.generic: The import could not be completed. No project content was changed.
errors.invalid_file: The selected Yarn project is invalid or exceeds the import safety limits.
errors.project_has_main_flow: This project already has a main flow, so the imported one could not be created. No project content was changed.
errors.preview_expired: This import preview expired before the import was started. Upload the file again.
errors.unauthorized: You no longer have permission to import into this project.
errors.unsupported_narrative: This Yarn project uses narrative logic that Storyarn cannot import safely. No project content was changed.
